MSQUEUECOMPAT001.title: MSMQ (System.Messaging) not supported in cloud
MSQUEUECOMPAT001.description: System.Messaging (MSMQ) is a Windows-only messaging technology that is not available in Azure App Service or containerized deployments. Replace with Azure Service Bus, Azure Queue Storage, or another cloud-native messaging solution.

SERVERMAPPATH001.title: Server.MapPath not available in cloud hosting
SERVERMAPPATH001.description: Server.MapPath resolves physical file paths on the server and is not supported outside of IIS/ASP.NET classic. Use IHostingEnvironment.WebRootPath or IWebHostEnvironment.ContentRootPath in ASP.NET Core, or store files in Azure Blob Storage.

HTTPPOSTEDFILE001.title: HttpPostedFileBase file upload requires migration
HTTPPOSTEDFILE001.description: HttpPostedFileBase is a System.Web type that is not available outside of ASP.NET on .NET Framework. Migrate to IFormFile (ASP.NET Core) and store uploaded files in Azure Blob Storage or a persistent volume.

SYSCONFIGMGR001.title: System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager usage
SYSCONFIGMGR001.description: ConfigurationManager reads from Web.config/App.config files. In cloud deployments, configuration should be externalized to environment variables, Azure App Configuration, or Key Vault.

WEBCONFIG001.title: Web.config-based configuration not supported in cloud
WEBCONFIG001.description: Web.config is an IIS-specific configuration mechanism. Migrate configuration to appsettings.json, environment variables, or Azure App Configuration for cloud deployments.

LOCALDB001.title: LocalDB connection string not suitable for cloud
LOCALDB001.description: The connection string references SQL Server LocalDB which is a development-only database. Replace with a cloud-accessible SQL Server or Azure SQL Database connection string managed through environment variables or Key Vault.

LEGACYFRAMEWORK001.title: Legacy ASP.NET MVC 5 on .NET Framework 4.8
LEGACYFRAMEWORK001.description: The project targets .NET Framework 4.8 using ASP.NET MVC 5. Migrate to ASP.NET Core on .NET 8 or later to benefit from cross-platform support, improved performance, and cloud-native features.

PACKAGESCFG001.title: Legacy packages.config format
PACKAGESCFG001.description: The project uses the legacy packages.config format for NuGet references. Migrate to PackageReference format in the .csproj file for better dependency management and compatibility with the .NET SDK.

GLOBALASAX001.title: Global.asax application lifecycle not available
GLOBALASAX001.description: Global.asax is an IIS/ASP.NET-specific application lifecycle handler. Migrate startup logic to Program.cs and Startup.cs in ASP.NET Core using the middleware pipeline and hosted services.

IISEXPRESS001.title: IIS-specific hosting configuration
IISEXPRESS001.description: The project is configured for IIS/IIS Express hosting (ProjectTypeGuids reference IIS). Cloud deployments typically use Kestrel or Docker containers. Remove IIS-specific project type GUIDs and configure for cross-platform hosting.

properties.description: University management web application for courses, students, instructors, and departments

security.title: No authentication or authorization implemented
security.description: The application has no authentication or authorization mechanisms. All controllers and actions are publicly accessible. Implement ASP.NET Core Identity or Azure AD authentication before cloud deployment.

security.title: File upload without path traversal protection
security.description: The CoursesController uploads files to a server path constructed from user input. While file extension validation exists, there is no defense against path traversal attacks. Use a safe file storage approach (Azure Blob Storage) with server-generated filenames.

security.title: MSMQ queue permissions set to Everyone/FullControl
security.description: The NotificationService grants FullControl permissions on the MSMQ queue to 'Everyone'. This is overly permissive and should be restricted to the application's service account.
